provenance.source: wowhandbook.com talent data extracted from WoW: Forever beta client
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425; talent data may still change before the Nov 5 launch. Cross-checked against Blizzard class deep-dive posts.

description.zh: 使你的生命分流法术所转化的法力值提高20%。
description.en: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 20%.

description.zh: 使你的命中几率提高5%，并使你产生的所有威胁降低20%。
description.en: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.

description.zh: 使你的腐蚀术的施法时间缩短2秒，造成的伤害提高10%。
description.en: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%.

description.zh: 使你的痛苦系法术的射程延长20%。
description.en: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by 20%.

description.zh: 杀死一个受你的吸取灵魂影响的非无价值目标后，使你的法力恢复速度提高100%，持续10秒，并使正常法力恢复的100%在施法时继续生效。
description.en: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by 100% for 10 sec and allows 100% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

description.zh: 使你的吸取生命、吸取灵魂和Wrack吸取的生命值或造成的伤害提高20%。
description.en: Increases health drained or damage done by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 20%.

description.zh: 使你的痛苦灾祸造成的伤害提高10%。
description.en: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 10%.

description.zh: 使你在引导或施放吸取生命、吸取法力、吸取灵魂或Wrack时，有70%的几率避免因受到伤害而被打断。
description.en: Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling or casting your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, or Wrack spells.

description.zh: 使你的下一个虚弱诅咒或痛苦灾祸的效果提高50%，或使你的下一个疲劳诅咒的效果提高50%。持续30秒。
description.en: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 50%. Lasts 30 sec.

description.zh: 使你的腐蚀术、痛苦灾祸、末日灾祸、吸取灵魂、吸取生命、生命虹吸和Wrack的致命一击伤害加成提高100%。
description.en: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%.

description.zh: 使你的暗影法术爆击几率提高5%。
description.en: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by 5%.

description.zh: 使你的腐蚀术、吸取灵魂、吸取生命和Wrack在对敌人造成伤害后有4%的几率使你进入暗影冥思状态。暗影冥思使你的下一个暗影箭的施法时间缩短100%。
description.en: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

description.zh: 使目标的速度降低30%，持续12秒。每个术士只能对一个目标施加一种诅咒，且同类诅咒不能叠加。
description.en: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

description.zh: 每3秒从目标身上吸取11点生命值转移给施法者。持续30秒。
description.en: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

description.zh: 目标身上每有一个你的其他痛苦效果，你的吸取生命、吸取灵魂和Wrack造成的伤害或吸取的生命值就提高12%，最多提高36%。
description.en: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 12% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 36%.

description.zh: 使你的暗影法术所造成的伤害或吸取的生命值提高10%。
description.en: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 10%.

description.zh: 从内部撕裂目标，每1秒造成36点暗影伤害，并使目标受到你其他暗影持续伤害效果的伤害提高10%。持续6秒。
description.en: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.

description.zh: 使你的生命通道转移的生命值提高40%，生命值消耗降低30%，并使生命通道产生的所有威胁降低100%。无论恶魔的生命值如何都可以使用生命通道。
description.en: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

description.zh: 使你的小鬼的火焰箭造成的伤害提高30%，火焰之盾的效果提高30%。
description.en: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 30% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 30%.

description.zh: 使你的耐力总值提高15%。
description.en: Increases your total Stamina by 15%.

description.zh: 使你的小鬼、虚空行者、魅魔、夜魔和地狱猎犬宠物造成的所有伤害提高10%。
description.en: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 10%.

description.zh: 使你的恶魔皮肤和恶魔护甲法术的效果提高30%。
description.en: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 30%.

description.zh: 使你的虚空行者的折磨、吞噬暗影、牺牲和受难法术效果提高30%。
description.en: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 30%.

description.zh: 使你的小鬼、虚空行者、魅魔、夜魔和地狱猎犬的生命值与法力值上限提高15%，并使你的法力值上限提高15%。
description.en: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.

description.zh: 你造成的所有法术伤害会为宠物恢复相当于该伤害15%的生命值。通过生命分流获得法力时，召唤的恶魔会获得相当于你所得法力100%的法力。
description.en: You heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.

description.zh: 使你的魅魔和夜魔的剧痛鞭笞和安抚之吻法术的效果提高30%，并使你的魅魔和夜魔的诱惑和次级隐形术的持续时间延长30%。
description.en: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 30%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

description.zh:
激活后，牺牲你召唤的恶魔来强化你力量的相反面向，使你获得一个持续2小时的效果。如果召唤任何恶魔，该效果会被取消。

小鬼：使你的暗影伤害提高15%。

虚空行者：每4秒恢复总法力值的2%。

魅魔/夜魔：使你的火焰伤害提高15%。

地狱猎犬：每4秒恢复总生命值的3%。
description.en:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

description.zh: 使你召唤小鬼、虚空行者、魅魔、夜魔和地狱猎犬的施法时间减少4秒，法力值消耗降低40%。
description.en: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.

description.zh: 使你的灵魂之火冷却时间缩短90%。当你对生命值低于35%的敌人施放暗影箭或灼热之痛时，这些法术造成的伤害提高6%，并且在接下来的10秒内，你的灵魂之火施法时间缩短40%，且不消耗灵魂碎片。
description.en: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 90%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 6% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 40% and costs no Soul Shards.

description.zh: 你的下一个召唤小鬼、虚空行者、魅魔、夜魔或地狱猎犬的法术施法时间减少5.5秒，法力消耗减少50%。
description.en: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

description.zh: 你的灼热之痛产生的威胁降低50%，并标记目标10秒。你的宠物接下来对目标的6次攻击会根据宠物类型造成65至68点火焰或暗影伤害。造成暗影伤害时会产生高威胁。
description.en: Your Searing Pain generates 50% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 6 attacks against the target deal 65 to 68 Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.

description.zh: 使你的地狱猎犬的腐坏之血的攻击强度降低效果、吞噬魔法的治疗效果以及多疑的侦测等级提高30%，并使其法术封锁的冷却时间缩短6秒。
description.en: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 30%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 6 sec.

description.zh: 激活时，施法者受到的所有伤害有30%由你的小鬼、虚空行者、魅魔、夜魔或地狱猎犬恶魔承受。此外，恶魔和主人造成的伤害都提高3%。只要恶魔处于激活状态，该效果就会持续。
description.en: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

description.zh: 召唤的恶魔宠物激活时，使你和恶魔宠物的法术伤害最多提高相当于你等级100%的数值。
description.en: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

description.zh:
只要召唤的恶魔保持激活，使术士和该恶魔获得一个效果。

小鬼 - 火焰伤害提高10%。

虚空行者 - 受到的物理伤害降低10%。

魅魔/夜魔 - 暗影伤害提高10%。

地狱猎犬 - 受到的魔法伤害降低10%。
description.en:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 10%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%.

Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 10%.

Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 10%.

description.zh: 你的恶魔牺牲效果不再因召唤其它不同的恶魔宠物而取消。重新召唤已被牺牲的宠物仍会取消该效果。
description.en: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

description.zh: 使你的伤害法术射程提高20%。
description.en: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by 20%.

description.zh: 你的暗影箭爆击会使目标受到来自你攻击的暗影伤害提高20%，持续12秒。
description.en: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 20% for 12 sec.

description.zh: 使你的暗影箭、献祭和烧尽的施法时间缩短0.5秒，灵魂之火的施法时间缩短2秒。
description.en: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.

description.zh: 使你受到的所有伤害降低10%。
description.en: Reduces all damage taken by 10%.

description.zh: 使你的毁灭系法术所消耗的法力值减少10%。
description.en: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.

description.zh: 使你的献祭的初始伤害提高50%，并且你的燃烧有100%的几率使目标眩晕，移动速度降低50%，持续5秒。
description.en: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 50% and your Conflagrate spell has a 100% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

description.zh: 使你的毁灭系法术的爆击伤害加成提高100%。
description.en: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%.

description.zh: 立即冲击目标，造成65点暗影伤害。若消灭一个能为你提供经验值或荣誉值的敌人，且其在受到暗影灼烧后的8秒内死亡，则施法者获得一块灵魂碎片。
description.en: Instantly blasts the target for 65 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

description.zh: 使你有70%的几率在施放或引导任何毁灭系法术时不会因受到伤害而被打断。
description.en: Gives you a 70% chance to resist interruption caused by damage while casting or channeling any Destruction spell.

description.zh: 使你的灼热之痛的爆击几率提高10%，并使你所有毁灭系法术造成的伤害提高10%。
description.en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 10%.

description.zh: 点燃一个已经受到你的献祭法术影响的目标，造成87点火焰伤害，并消耗献祭效果。
description.en: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 87 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

description.zh: 使你的灵魂之火有26%的几率令目标昏迷3秒，并使你的火焰之雨和地狱烈焰在持续期间有26%的几率令受到伤害的目标昏迷3秒。
description.en: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 26% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 26% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

description.zh: 使目标遭受浩劫灾祸，持续5分钟，术士对其他目标造成的所有伤害有15%也会施加给被诅咒的目标。浩劫灾祸只能影响1个目标，且每个术士在任一目标身上只能维持一种灾祸。
description.en: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

description.zh: 使你的燃烧法术爆击几率提高25%。
description.en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by 25%.

description.zh: 使用燃烧击中敌人后，你造成的所有暗影伤害提高10%，持续20秒。使用暗影灼烧击中敌人后，你造成的所有火焰伤害提高10%，持续20秒。此外，燃烧有100%的几率不消耗献祭，暗影灼烧有100%的几率立刻返还一块灵魂碎片。
description.en: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 10% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 10% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 100% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 100% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

description.zh: 对你的目标造成98点火焰伤害，如果目标受到献祭的影响，则额外造成25%的伤害。
description.en: Deals 98 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
